# Yggdrasil — project operations guide

Operational knowledge for working on this repo. (General working style — TDD,
worktrees, surgical changes — lives in the user's global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.)

Yggdrasil is a macOS SwiftUI app (Apple Silicon only). Xcode project is
**generated by XcodeGen** from `project.yml` — never hand-edit
`Yggdrasil.xcodeproj`; edit `project.yml` and run `make project`.

## Build, test, lint

- `make project` — regenerate `Yggdrasil.xcodeproj` from `project.yml` (xcodegen).
- `make build` / `make test` — xcodebuild the `Yggdrasil` scheme.
- `make lint` / `make format` / `make format-lint` — see tooling note below.

### Linters are version-pinned in the Makefile (single source of truth)
SwiftFormat and SwiftLint are **not** installed via brew. The Makefile pins
`SWIFTFORMAT_VERSION` / `SWIFTLINT_VERSION` and downloads those exact release
binaries into `.tools/` (gitignored) on first use. `make format` / `make lint`
/ `make format-lint` run the pinned binaries, and **CI calls the same make
targets** — so local and CI are identical and the runner image's bundled tool
versions are irrelevant.

- The repo has **never** conformed to swiftformat ≥ 0.52 defaults; do not "fix"
  CI by upgrading the formatter. To bump a tool: change the version var in the
  Makefile **and reformat the tree in the same PR** (`make format`), then verify
  `make lint` still passes (the two tools can conflict — e.g. swiftformat's
  `redundantReturn` vs swiftlint's `void_function_in_ternary`, which is disabled
  in `.swiftlint.yml` for that reason).
- swiftformat caches results in `~/Library/Caches/com.charcoaldesign.swiftformat`
  keyed by content; a stale cache gives misleading `--lint` results. `make
  format-lint` uses an explicit `--config` + cache path to stay deterministic.

## Local Release build + install

CI builds the signed/notarized DMG; for a quick local install (e.g. to dogfood
an unmerged branch):

```sh
xcodebuild -project Yggdrasil.xcodeproj -scheme Yggdrasil -configuration Release \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/derived \
  ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO build
cp -R build/derived/Build/Products/Release/Yggdrasil.app /Applications/Yggdrasil.app
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Yggdrasil.app
```

- **`ARCHS=arm64` is required.** Homebrew's libgit2 is arm64-only on the build
  machine, so a default (arm64 + x86_64) Release build fails at the x86_64 link
  step. Yggdrasil is Apple-Silicon-only; Intel is not a target.
- A local build is **ad-hoc signed** and links Homebrew libgit2 by absolute path
  (`/opt/homebrew/opt/libgit2/...`). It runs fine on a machine with that libgit2
  installed but is **not** self-contained — don't redistribute it. For a
  shareable build, `Scripts/bundle-libgit2.sh <app>` vendors every Homebrew dylib
  into `Contents/Frameworks` (then re-sign), which is what the release workflow
  does before notarizing.

## App data / config locations (survives reinstall)

Config is **not** stored in the app bundle — it's keyed by the bundle id
(`com.bsvassociation.yggdrasil`, identical for Debug and Release), so any build
shares the same data:

- **Database** (repos, agents, tabs, settings, GitHub task/status cache):
  `~/Library/Application Support/Yggdrasil/yggdrasil.sqlite` (GRDB; migrations in
  `Yggdrasil/Core/Storage/Migrations.swift`, applied forward on launch).
- **UserDefaults** (terminal theme, group-by-repo, appearance):
  `~/Library/Preferences/com.bsvassociation.yggdrasil.plist`.
- **GitHub auth**: external — `gh auth token` (`~/.config/gh`). REST + GraphQL
  go through the same token (`Yggdrasil/Core/Auth/`).

Switching builds: quit any running instance first (don't let two write the same
sqlite), and note that a newer build may forward-migrate the DB one-way (back up
the sqlite before testing a schema-changing build).

## Releasing

Releases are **tag-driven**. `release.yml` triggers on a pushed `v*.*.*` tag,
builds + signs (Developer ID) + notarizes the DMG, and creates a **draft**
GitHub release with the DMG + SHA256SUMS. Steps:

1. Bump the version in **both** `project.yml` *and* `Yggdrasil/Info.plist`
   (`CFBundleShortVersionString` + `CFBundleVersion`) — both are tracked and
   must stay in sync (xcodegen regenerates Info.plist from project.yml, but the
   committed file is what reviewers diff). Commit as
   `chore(release): bump to X.Y.Z` with the changelog in the body.
2. Land that on `main`, then tag the bump commit: `git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "Yggdrasil vX.Y.Z" && git push origin vX.Y.Z`.
3. The workflow produces a **draft** release — edit notes and **publish manually**.

## CI & branch protection

- `main` requires an approving PR review (a repo ruleset, not classic branch
  protection). Auto-merge is disabled. Land work via PR; merging needs a review
  or an admin override: `gh pr merge <n> --squash --admin`.
- CI (`ci.yml`) runs on PRs/pushes: `make format-lint`, `make lint`, `make
  build`, `make test`. Build/test pull the Metal toolchain + SwiftPM packages,
  so a full run is ~15 min.
